verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos or walk into a loaded Q+W combo before level 6; you win if you survive to the Titanic Hydra power spike and let Stand United swing other lanes.

brief.thesis: Riven's Runic Blade passive turns her basic attacks into bonus-damage hits every time she casts, so any extended auto-trade bleeds you faster than it bleeds her, and her Q (Broken Wings, 13s cooldown) stacked with W (Ki Burst, 11/10/9/8/7s) can stun-lock and burst you before your E (Shadow Dash, 16/14/12/10/8s) is even up. The 47.7% win rate over 664 games and Riven's lane/solo-kill edge both come from that early trading math, not from anything unwinnable long-term.

theirWindow.when: Q and W both off cooldown near you
theirWindow.what: She can stun with W (Ki Burst) then dump all three Q (Broken Wings) charges plus empowered autos from Runic Blade. Hold W (Feint) in reserve rather than using it preemptively, and don't trade autos with her in this window.

yourWindow.when: right as her E (Valor) lands on you
yourWindow.what: Per the live matchup data, use E (Shadow Dash) reactively the instant she dashes in rather than initiating with it yourself — the taunt locks her down for your Q (Vorpal Blade) and allied follow-up before she can reposition.

start.why: Measured as the 65.5% pick at 50.3% win rate over 519 games — its single-target damage reduction directly answers Riven mixing autos between abilities, and it pairs with Second Wind for sustain in short trades.

boots.why: 83.9% pick rate at 50.3% win over 626 games. Riven's whole damage model is empowered autos off her Runic Blade passive, so flat auto-attack reduction is the correct boots here, not magic resist.

core.why: First item in the 49.1% win rate, 15.4% pick path — the stacking passive and wave clear let you hold lane without needing to win auto trades directly.
Second item in that same core path; adds the stat spread that lets you survive her all-in windows past level 6.
Third item in the highest-sample core path (53 games); punishes her for the exact auto-attack-heavy trading pattern her kit is built around.

situational.when: she's snowballing on crit or attack speed and the Q+W all-in keeps landing clean
your team needs more peel or utility than a straight tank item provides
you need an earlier spike against her auto-reliant damage than Thornmail's timing allows
the game goes long and you want more raw HP to out-scale her duel potential

runes.keystoneWhy: Highest-performing page in the data (51.4% win, 34.1% pick). Grasp's proc sustains you through the poke-and-auto pattern Riven uses to win early trades, which is exactly where this matchup is lost if unanswered.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the highest win rate at real volume (49.4% over the majority 67.7% pick share), and Ignite punishes Riven for over-extending her E (Valor) engage before her Second Wind-denying burst is fully online.

playing.title: Never auto-trade freely
playing.detail: Her Runic Blade passive makes every few autos hit harder than yours. Trade with Q (Vorpal Blade) procs and allied minion damage instead of standing in autos.

playing.title: Hold W for the real combo
playing.detail: Save Feint for the moment she commits Q (Broken Wings) and W (Ki Burst) together, not for chip damage — that's the one window the live-data tip calls out directly.

playing.title: React with E, don't open with it
playing.detail: Shadow Dash's taunt is strongest as a punish the instant her E (Valor) lands her in range, locking her in place before she can reposition.

playing.title: Short-trade and reset
playing.detail: Vorpal Blade's life tap rewards poke-and-retreat over standing fights, especially before level 6 when her all-in is strongest.

playing.title: Play for the item spike
playing.detail: Levels 9-13 with Titanic Hydra online is your real power window — look to force fights here instead of levels 1-5.

playing.title: Use R to shift the map
playing.detail: Stand United's 200/180/160/160/160s cooldown global teleport-shield is strongest once you're ahead structurally; use it to swing other lanes rather than saving it purely to survive Riven duels.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune, and summoner numbers are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the power-curve and trade-pattern reasoning connecting them to Shen's and Riven's actual ability cooldowns and mechanics is this brief's own analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Riven deals a lot of damage because she mixes basic attacks in between her skills. Use [W] to ignore Riven’s basic attacks and gain the upper hand in combat. Rather than initiating combat with Taunt, try to use [E] in response to Riven closing in.
